metadata.title: Very high genus double Hurwitz numbers via mixing times
metadata.abstract: We obtain very high genus asymptotics for double Hurwitz numbers when both the size $n$ and the genus $g$ go to infinity, under the constraint that $g$ grows much faster than $n$, more precisely that $\frac{2g}{n}-\ln n\to\infty$. Our proof relies on adapting arguments about the mixing time of the transposition random walk introduced by Diaconis and Shahshahani.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 极高亏格双 Hurwitz 数渐近
analysis.workSummary: 当大小 n 与亏格 g 同时趋于无穷且 2g/n−ln n→∞ 时，获得双 Hurwitz 数的渐近公式。证明改造 Diaconis–Shahshahani 的换位随机游走混合时间论证。
analysis.breakthrough: 用对称群混合速度控制极高亏格的分支覆盖计数。
analysis.limitations: 必须位于给定极高亏格区间，不能涵盖固定亏格或 g 与 n 同阶的全部区域。
analysis.priorityReason: 覆盖计数与概率混合的具体交叉应用。
